description: Clarify that a rope tied to cargo below is not an upper descent anchor, while preserving haul-back recovery from the canonical one-way chimney

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-SPAN-BLOCK? ()
    <COND (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
                <IN? ,ROPE ,WINNER>
                <NOT <ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
                <VERB? WALK WALK-TO WALK-AROUND THROUGH ENTER EXIT
                       CLIMB-UP CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-FOO LEAP>>
           <COND (<UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-RETURN-ACTION?> <RFALSE>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The rope draws taut toward the brown sack at the other end of the vertical run. You can haul the sack, or return along the line; wandering away would require more rope than you have." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)>)>
    <RFALSE>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-SPAN-BLOCK? ()
    <COND (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
                <IN? ,ROPE ,WINNER>
                <NOT <ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
                <VERB? WALK WALK-TO WALK-AROUND THROUGH ENTER EXIT
                       CLIMB-UP CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-FOO LEAP>>
           <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN>
                       <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,STUDIO>
                       <VERB? WALK>
                       <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>
                  <TELL "The rope is tied to the sack below, not anchored above. It gives you a cargo line, not a safe way down this one-way chimney. Haul the sack back up if you need the line with you." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)
                 (<UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-RETURN-ACTION?> <RFALSE>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The rope draws taut toward the brown sack at the other end of the vertical run. You can haul the sack, or return where the world already provides a route; wandering away would require more rope than you have." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)>)>
    <RFALSE>>
